findings.highlight: Her older sister is bitter
findings.evidenceJa: 姉は辛辣だった
findings.governingReading: Sakura experiences her sister’s treatment as harsh and cutting.
findings.explanation: The English changes Rin’s sharp severity toward Sakura into personal bitterness.

findings.highlight: She corners Sakura, even when she knows of her uneasiness
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が背負った不安と負い目を知った上で、容赦なく少女を追い詰める
findings.governingReading: Rin relentlessly corners Sakura despite knowing both the anxiety and burden of guilt or indebtedness she carries.
findings.explanation: The English omits Sakura’s burden and Rin’s lack of mercy.

findings.highlight: Pushing her resolve
findings.evidenceJa: 全身に喝をいれて
findings.governingReading: Sakura sharply rallies her entire body against Rin’s pressure.
findings.explanation: The English abstracts the embodied act of forcing herself into action as “pushing her resolve.”

findings.highlight: Rin cuts off the girl
findings.evidenceJa: 凛は一言で斬り伏せる
findings.governingReading: Rin cuts Sakura down with a single utterance.
findings.explanation: The English retains interruption but loses both the decisive one-line scope and the verbal sword-stroke image.

findings.highlight: Even if you and Rider are just staying in the house without fighting
findings.evidenceJa: 戦闘に参加せずライダーでこの家を守ろうが
findings.governingReading: Even if Sakura stays out of battle and uses Rider to protect the house, Rin still regards her as Zouken’s pawn.
findings.explanation: The English turns Rider’s active defense of the house into Sakura and Rider passively staying there.

findings.highlight: you’re under Zouken’s control
findings.evidenceJa: 貴女が臓硯の手駒である事
findings.governingReading: Rin calls Sakura one of Zouken’s pawns.
findings.explanation: The English weakens Sakura’s instrumental role in Rin’s accusation into being generally under Zouken’s control.

findings.highlight: they will end up as enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が敵に回ると極め付けてさえいる
findings.governingReading: Sakura suspects Rin may already have concluded that Sakura herself will turn enemy.
findings.explanation: The English uses a plural subject and recasts Sakura’s feared betrayal as the sisters mutually ending up enemies.

findings.highlight: her memory is becoming more vague
findings.evidenceJa: 記憶もバラバラになりつつある
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s memory is progressively breaking into pieces.
findings.explanation: The English replaces ongoing fragmentation with nonspecific vagueness.

findings.highlight: she’s begun having nightmares
findings.evidenceJa: 怖い夢ばかりで安らげない
findings.governingReading: Her sleep, formerly her only rest, now brings nothing but frightening dreams and no repose.
findings.explanation: The English mentions nightmares but omits their exclusivity and the resulting inability to rest.

findings.highlight: if she goes crazy
findings.evidenceJa: 理性を失ってもおかしくない
findings.governingReading: Sakura judges that she could lose her reason at any time.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the precise fear of losing rational control with the stigmatizing and less exact “goes crazy.”

findings.highlight: when you have no magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力不足の体
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s body is deficient in magical energy.
findings.explanation: The English turns insufficiency into complete absence.

findings.highlight: Emiya-kun will worry if you push yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 無理をすればするほど衛宮くんが心配する
findings.governingReading: The more Sakura overexerts herself, the more Shirou will worry.
findings.explanation: The English removes the explicitly proportional escalation between her strain and his concern.

findings.highlight: Sakura drops her gaze further
findings.evidenceJa: なお深く頭を下げた
findings.governingReading: Sakura bows her head still more deeply.
findings.explanation: The English turns a submissive bodily bow into a change in where she looks.

findings.highlight: She nods
findings.evidenceJa: こくん、と小さく頷く
findings.governingReading: Sakura gives a small, subdued nod.
findings.explanation: The English removes the gesture’s small, restrained quality.

findings.highlight: you’re seeing him
findings.evidenceJa: 今日も先輩を呼び出して
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Rin summoned Shirou again today.
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin’s agency and the repeated summoning, reducing it to seeing him.

findings.highlight: I’m teaching him magic
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術講座よ
findings.governingReading: Rin calls the procedure a magecraft lesson.
findings.explanation: The English collapses the technical discipline into generic magic.

findings.highlight: that experience will flow continuously into Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎が眠っていても一方的に経験値が流れ込んでいって
findings.governingReading: Experience will flow unilaterally into Shirou even while he sleeps.
findings.explanation: The English retains continuous flow but omits both its one-way nature and that it operates during sleep.

findings.highlight: the puppet will be washed away
findings.evidenceJa: 人形は跡形もなく崩れ去る
findings.governingReading: The clay figure collapses and disintegrates without leaving a trace before the tsunami.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes displacement by water for the analogy’s destruction of the fragile mind.

findings.highlight: She stares straight at her sister
findings.evidenceJa: 己が理想である姉を凝視する
findings.governingReading: Sakura stares directly at the sister who embodies her own ideal.
findings.explanation: The English omits the idealization that makes Sakura’s confrontation psychologically costly.

findings.highlight: make him create a weapon within set limitations
findings.evidenceJa: そのギリギリのうちに戦う道具を作らせること
findings.governingReading: Rin’s role is to make Shirou create a weapon before he reaches the very edge of his endurance.
findings.explanation: The English misreads the temporal window before his breaking point as unspecified “set limitations.”

findings.highlight: that is her mind as Tohsaka Rin
findings.evidenceJa: それは遠坂凛としての心
findings.governingReading: Sakura distinguishes Rin’s caring heart as Rin from the other motive she knows as a fellow heir.
findings.explanation: The English converts heart or motive into “mind” and the competing motive into a vague “other side.”

findings.highlight: the law of magi
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての規律
findings.governingReading: Sakura invokes the discipline or code Rin follows as a magus.
findings.explanation: The English invents a collective legal regime in place of Rin’s internalized professional discipline.

findings.highlight: His life was saved because I gave him my Archer’s arm
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎はわたしのアーチャーから腕を貰って一命を取り留めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou survived by receiving an arm from Rin’s Archer.
findings.explanation: The English transfers the act of giving the arm to Rin herself.

findings.highlight: Shirou has no right to object
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎に発言権はない
findings.governingReading: Rin claims Shirou has no right to speak in the matter at all.
findings.explanation: The English narrows her sweeping denial of voice to a lack of standing to object.

findings.highlight: he’s still bearing it
findings.evidenceJa: あの腕に耐えながら受け入れている
findings.governingReading: Shirou continues to accept the arm while enduring it.
findings.explanation: The English retains endurance but omits the acceptance on which Rin bases her possessive argument.

findings.highlight: The girl watches it as if it’s a distant scene
findings.evidenceJa: その後ろ姿を、少女は遠い風景のように見つめている
findings.governingReading: Sakura watches Rin’s retreating back as though it were a distant landscape.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Rin’s visible retreating figure with the unclear pronoun “it.”

findings.highlight: So you’re taking Senpai as well, Nee-san?
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩まで獲っていってしまうの、姉さん
findings.governingReading: In a flat voice, Sakura resignedly states that Rin is taking even Shirou away from her.
findings.explanation: The English punctuates the statement as a question, weakening its settled accusation and despair.
